checks.requirement: The official notice is active and its identity and deadline are explicit.
The official four-page draft SOW attachment is preserved with exact binary custody.
The notice permits teaming but requires names and roles only when a team is proposed.
The current public credential configuration contains environment references only and its receipt matches the current file.

checks.blocker: Rotate the affected provider credentials, record non-secret receipts, remediate reachable public Git history, and verify the remote before linking or promoting the repository.
checks.requirement: Previously exposed provider credentials are rotated and prior public Git objects are remediated before the repository is linked or promoted.

checks.blocker: Rebuild the current security receipt and remove every repository, live-site, hyperlink, external relationship, PDF action, and embedded file from the Government attachment set.
checks.evidence: security_receipt_current=True; sanitized_external_response_allowed=True; final_argos_send_allowed_by_security_gate=True; attachment_repo_isolated=True; found_routes=[]; docx_external_relationship_count=0; pdf_actions=[]; pdf_open_action=False; pdf_embedded_files=False
checks.requirement: The Government response is self-contained, link-free, and allowed by the current targeted security gate.
The response is evaluated before the exact Government deadline.
Both accepted review formats and their receipts are present.
Markdown, DOCX, and PDF hashes reconcile to the current receipts.
Every DOCX section uses US Letter dimensions.
Every DOCX section uses one-inch content margins.
The Normal style is Times New Roman 12 point.
The response stays within ten content pages excluding the cover.
Every rendered page is inspected without clipping or overlap.

checks.blocker: Insert only currently verified private entity and contact facts in the private final copy.
checks.requirement: Every required cover fact is resolved and no placeholder remains.

checks.blocker: Use a truthful standalone disclosure with no outside names or roles, or bind every proposed team member and role to written authority.
checks.evidence: response_mode=STANDALONE_RESPONDENT; teaming_proposed=False; subcontracting_proposed=False; proposed_team_organizations=[]; required_teaming_fact_count=0; candidate_name_authorizations=0; teamed_phrases_found=[]; standalone_disclosure_present=True
checks.requirement: The response mode, proposed-team state, and documentary disclosure are mutually consistent.
The Government response names no uncommitted teaming candidate.

checks.evidence: Explicit similar-scope matrix and acquisition implications are present.
checks.requirement: Adjacent component evidence is not represented as federal-health prior performance.
Unsupported certification, authorization, validation, savings, and prime claims remain prohibited.
Each affirmative engineering proof statement is bound to named first-party evidence and explicit non-claims.
The bounded partner inquiry was sent exactly once without attachments, CC, or BCC and is now duplicate-locked while awaiting a reply.

checks.blocker: Repeat the exact Government-response duplicate search immediately before send.
checks.requirement: A fresh full-mailbox duplicate check is bound to the final Government response.

checks.blocker: Build and inspect the private final action packet after the cover and response-mode gates pass.
checks.requirement: The final Government recipient, subject, body, and attachment set are verified together.

checks.blocker: Obtain exact action-time approval only after every other blocker is cleared.
checks.requirement: Single-use action-time human approval is bound to the exact Government dispatch.

claim_boundary: PASS means the named documentary or formatting requirement is supported. BLOCKED with blocks_send=true means the current artifact is intentionally not send-ready. BLOCKED with blocks_send=false is a separately tracked promotion or operational-control gap that does not prevent a self-contained link-free Government response. Neither passing checks nor a polished packet establishes submission, acceptance, selection, award, authorization, certification, external validation, field performance, or savings.
safest_next_action: Resolve the private cover facts, build and inspect the self-contained private final copy, rerun this gate, repeat the official-notice and full-mailbox duplicate checks, bind the exact dispatch, and request exact action-time approval. Continue provider credential rotation and public-history remediation before any repository link or public promotion.
